_comment: Local lab configuration. Mirrors chapter 7 of CDM_End_to_End_Specification.md. Swap points for production are marked SWAP.

servicenow_cmdb._swap: SWAP: replace cmdb/certificates.json reads with real ServiceNow CMDB API calls (FR-SYN-001).

sectigo._swap: SWAP: change mode back to "api" and set base_url to the real Sectigo tenant, routing credentials through CyberArk (FR-SRC-012), once Sectigo access exists.
sectigo._mode_note: mode can be "folder" (input_sectigo_certificates/), "api" (CA simulator), or "acme" (real ACME issuance via sources/acme_ca.py -- see acme_domains below).

vault._swap: SWAP: replace vault_stub/ with real CyberArk CCP calls (FR-SEC-001). This stub exists only so the rest of the system can be built and tested against the same interface.

renewal._note: deploy_on_landing is true in the lab so the demo does not have to wait for a real renewal window; set to false for production defaults (spec 7.4).
